Helping government meet the mission ahead

Backed by decades of trusted public-sector experience, Maximus brings advanced technology, operational expertise, and human-centered design to the programs that matter most. Across health, human services, veteran support, citizen experience, defense, and national security, we help agencies modernize with confidence and deliver impact at scale.

We are driving innovation and delivering impactful mission outcomes through emerging technologies, advanced architectures, and modern methodologies that accelerate IT transformation.
Our seamless integration of technology and service delivery ensures every interaction creates a holistic and exceptional journey.
We support government agencies in modernizing health programs and infrastructure through robust business solutions, advanced analytics, and innovative technology.
We help agencies transform policy goals into tangible outcomes, whether it's by optimizing service delivery, reshaping customer experience, or providing backlog management.
Why do government agencies choose Maximus?

Government agencies choose Maximus because we deliver results where mission, technology, and operations intersect. Our teams work alongside clients to solve complex challenges, improve service delivery, and build resilient programs designed for long-term success. The result is measurable impact for agencies and the people they serve.
Elevate citizen services with our omnichannel contact center solutions designed for federal and state agencies to improve efficiency and satisfaction.

Deliver secure, automated veteran services to enhance access, care quality, and continuity through AI and digital transformation.

pages.raw_meta: Maximus moves, builds, and delivers mission-critical systems and services that are secure, reliable, and scalable for multi-cloud environments.
raw_blocks: Accelerate mission success with secure, agile multi-cloud platforms that enable continuous modernization, operational agility, and innovation at government scale — without compromising compliance or security.
Secure, seamless cloud integration for mission-ready transformation
Simplifying hybrid and multi-cloud environments to accelerate modernization

We deliver FedRAMP-ready architectures that ensure government compliance while modernizing legacy applications for future-ready operations, enabling faster delivery of digital services, improved resiliency, and continuous modernization over time.
The result? A seamless, secure transition to AI-ready innovation and sustainable modernization across mission systems.
Cloud readiness, migration and integration

Move smarter, operate leaner, and modernize with purpose. We help agencies evolve from legacy environments to modern, cloud-native platforms that support rapid change, continuous improvement, and mission growth.
Enterprise cloud engineering and design

Our experts architect cloud-native solutions that integrate containerization and automated compliance, DevSecOps best practices and resilient application design, creating platforms that accelerate application modernization, data integration, and digital service delivery.
Cloud operations, optimization and modernization

Ensure your mission-critical systems operate securely, efficiently, and without disruption. Our cloud operations capabilities are designed to support continuous modernization — enabling agencies to adapt, optimize, and evolve systems as mission needs change.
Rethinking cybersecurity strategies for the cloud

Cloud infrastructure demands a different approach to cybersecurity than traditional government data centers. In this on-demand webinar, Maximus expert Frank Reyes explains why agencies must adapt their cybersecurity strategies to meet the unique challenges of cloud environments. Watch now to explore best practices for safeguarding cloud applications and infrastructure.
Proven cloud modernization driving real mission outcomes
Helping CMS modernize its Eligibility Appeals program
Maximus helped CMS modernize its Eligibility Appeals program with a cloud-native platform and digital tools — boosting online submissions to 80% and reducing hearing case volume by 71%.
Improving the Army’s Materiel Readiness with Cloud Migration

The U.S. Army migrated its materiel readiness systems to a secure, scalable cloud environment — boosting real-time visibility, strengthening cybersecurity, and improving supply chain efficiency to support faster, more reliable readiness.
Helping DoD modernize IT with cloud and CX

The DoD is integrating cloud, AI, and customer experience in its IT modernization — streamlining workflows, strengthening security, and boosting mission agility so service members can work smarter, faster, and more securely.
Data management and cloud strategies
Agencies need modern data management strategies that incorporate cloud capabilities in order to fully adapt to the data-driven paradigm. Discover how to start your plan and path forward.
Unlocking the power of cloud services
Cloud modernization is mission critical for multi-domain operations
Strategies for effective data modernization
Data and cloud solutions driving critical health missions
Strengthening Homeland Security with improved data management and cybersecurity
Striking the balance: Mission access and cybersecurity in cloud environments
Unleashing Cloud Innovations for Federal Transformation

Built to meet compliance and security requirements, our FedRAMP-authorized, multi-tenant Private and Government Community Hybrid Cloud designed exclusively for use by government customers only. Built to meet government compliance and security requirements, our managed Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) portfolio of solutions are hosted, managed, secured, and monitored to provide the highest scalability, reliability, and availability of mission-critical systems and services.
Learn more about our FedRAMP solutions
Good Faith and Safe Harbor Statement

Maximus is an AWS Partner with proven capabilities using AWS Cloud, Amazon Connect, Amazon Workspaces, and migrating customers to AWS Cloud. Learn more about our partnership with AWS and our technology alliance partners.
How do you balance cloud agility with security and compliance?

Maximus designs cloud environments that meet government security requirements from the start. Governance, cost management, and compliance are embedded so agencies can move faster without increasing risk.
Do you support hybrid and multi‑cloud environments?
Yes. We help agencies manage hybrid and multi‑cloud ecosystems efficiently — integrating legacy systems, avoiding vendor lock‑in, and maintaining operational continuity.
How does cloud modernization improve mission outcomes?
Cloud enables faster deployment, greater reliability, and scalable capacity — supporting surge demand, resilience, and continuous service delivery during mission‑critical moments.

At Maximus, we understand it takes the right strategies together with the right technologies to deliver impactful outcomes and exceptional customer experiences. We are dedicated to providing our federal government customers with innovative services and solutions that are delivered with agility and scale. We are committed to moving people and technology forward.

Join our team and be part of delivering federal technology solutions that empower government agencies across health, civilian, and defense. At Maximus, you'll drive innovation, impact public service, and help shape the future of government.
